To secure assets and ensure physical safety, we direct you to: 1) Strategically diversify investment portfolios, moving beyond singular tech dependencies to include sectors resilient to social and environmental pressures, and monitor regulatory shifts impacting AI. 2) Proactively assess and bolster critical supply chain resilience and local community preparedness against socio-economic instabilities and resource scarcity. 3) Immediately review and update emergency protocols for natural disasters, focusing on seismic event readiness and long-term climate-related vulnerabilities in your operational regions.
